text: Ben is 12, has mild CP and uses a walker. He's allowed to walk himself between the kids wing and the youth room now, he doesn't need an escort anymore, he'd be mortified. Stairs are different: he needs an adult right behind him on the stairs, every time. His brother Josh (17) is allowed to sign him out. He's fine with all foods and has no meds.
